findings.text: the one-tab control is said to have "reproduced the earlier probe's figures" and lists resize 13 ms, but the earlier probe's resize figures for the same client-pty 100->80 resize at the same scroll_buffer_size 50000 that this probe also ran are 418 ms (Claude Code pane) and 439 ms (plain-shell control) in the note's own table at lines 65-69, a 34x gap the sentence neither explains nor bounds; the new probe's own two numbers (12 ms and 13 ms) agree with each other, so the defect is the reproduction claim rather than the measurements.

the live scenario's committed log line is a superseded attempt (attach_ms 156, resize_ms 3748, resize_bytes 7475, mark_end 21,327) while the committed zj-second-live.marks.json and the 25,041-byte zj-second-live.bin capture carry a later run's values (attach_ms 147, resize_ms 3756, resize_bytes 10,247), which are also the numbers the note quotes; the log line carries no supersession marker, so a reader reconciling the log against the marks file finds an unexplained divergence, though both runs' stall delta is 33/33/0 so no conclusion changes.

item_verdicts.diff: One commit (7d2d1b18..386924e3) over 27 files, +1073/-7: the note in five hunks, a new landed-evidence section, a plan comment, two receipts, four probe scripts (multitab_client.py 245 lines, run_second_client.sh 105, render_capture.py 111, plot_timings.py 83) with their byte captures and rendered screens, and the regenerable timing figure; no production code changed.
item_verdicts.done_when: The five checks the gate names each re-ran true on the reviewed head: reckon audit-doc on the note exits 0; grep -c 'did not complete within' on docs/figures/fleet-view-rendering/evidence-probe/stall-lines.txt returns 33 with the header no longer self-matching; the note at line 83 and the archive carry 23:44:22.329; zellij on the fleet socket dir lists only fleet-demo, ambix-fleet and reckon-fleet live with /tmp/zj-second-client gone; and the reviewed run's own stream holds the final live run's line RESULT live stall_before=33 stall_after=33 delta=0.
item_verdicts.goal: The node was to answer the three questions the note left open — a second client at a different size attaching to a throwaway session with at least four tabs, the tab-bar row rendered through a VT emulator, and a live Claude Code pane resized between two widths — from throwaway sessions on the fleet node; I re-derived all three from the committed captures rather than from the manifest: the four-tab second client attaches at 60 columns and renders in 159 ms (second client 307 ms, 11,501 bytes, server_error false) against the one-tab control's 163 ms, the tab bar renders with neither dropped nor duplicated rows, and the live 100->70 resize reflows in 3,756 ms and 10,247 bytes with zero duplicated content rows, so the goal is met as written.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; status complete, commit 386924e3 with base 7d2d1b18, the five gate checks recorded with their results, the negative-control receipt named as a bare path, the four-tab panic reported under follow_ons, and `reckon crew check-manifest --run r-20260925T002909698111-fleet-view-unseen-surfaces` returns ok:true with no findings; the deductions are an empty test_logs and a tests line stating results rather than the commands that produced them.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares five paths (the note, the fleet-view-rendering figures directory, the landed-evidence archive, the plan, the plan's figures directory); the single commit changes 27 files — the note (+70), the archive (+44), the plan (+18), stall-lines.txt (9 changed lines), stall-deltas.txt and second-client-timings.png (new), and the evidence-second-client and probe-second-client directories — every path inside the fence and none outside it.

justifications.durability: The change commits its receipts and reproducible captures in-tree, so the note's numbers trace to a marks file and a byte-identical re-render and the zero-stall claim corroborates against the live log; the deductions are that one committed receipt (run.log) misstates the live run it is read as describing, and no check would fail if any number in the note regressed.
justifications.evidence: Every load-bearing number was re-derived from committed artifacts rather than read from the manifest — the four marks files carry exactly the figures the note quotes (159/307/11,501 and 12 ms/8,738; control 163/225/13; live 147/3,756/10,247), all six screens re-render byte-identically through the committed renderer under a fresh pyte, the receipt re-counts 33 and the live fleet log holds the same 33 lines with its last write at 22:30:48.186, and the 02:52:05 panic line in the committed excerpt is corroborated in that log; the two deductions are the control's reproduction claim (13 ms against the note's own 418-439 ms resize column at the same scroll_buffer_size 50000) and run.log's live section, a superseded attempt (attach_ms 156, resize_bytes 7,475, mark_end 21,327) sitting beside the marks file and the 25,041-byte capture that carry a later run's values.
justifications.fit: The note keeps its meta block and section idiom, the landed section matches the plan's house form, the receipts sit beside their measurement with headers naming source and command, and the figure follows the docs/figures/<topic>/ convention with a project-absolute src; the deductions are the plan's new header-duplicate link-check warning and a manifest that records its gate as prose results with an empty test_logs.
justifications.goal_fidelity: All three questions are answered in the note's new section (docs/research/fleet-view-rendering.html:180-231) with the receipts the gate named, and each answer was re-derived independently here from the committed marks, captures and screens; the deduction is that the one-tab control paragraph claims to reproduce the earlier probe's figures including a resize column that differs from the note's own measured table by ~34x.
justifications.scope_discipline: All 27 changed paths sit inside the declared fence; the plan edit appends the landed section without touching the plan-version or plan-modified meta lines; the archive edit is a pure append (+44, no deletions) to a cumulative record; audit-doc --check-links on the plan moves from 3 to 5 warnings (a landed-section header and a route-style archive link whose #fleet-view-unseen-surfaces anchor exists in the archive — house forms), while the note and the archive carry no new warnings.
